results.remarks: Custom built Ranch style home and turnkey horse property with extensive facilities in the sought-after Antelope Acres / West Lancaster area has ended. Welcome to this private ranch retreat on 2.5 flat, fully usable acres! This charming single-story home sits on beautifully maintained grounds and offers easy accommodations for up to 6 horses. The residence features 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, with the former garage thoughtfully converted into additional living space complete with its own ceiling fan and private entrance. Step under the covered entry and you're greeted by a spacious formal dining room to the right, a flexible bedroom or office to the left, and a generous living room anchored by beautiful French doors that open to the private backyard and lush sodded area. The kitchen boasts tile countertops, plenty of storage, and flows naturally into the living and dining spaces. Throughout the home you'll appreciate warm Mahogany doors and handsome Knotty Alder cabinetry. The primary suite is a true retreat with an ensuite bath featuring a soaking tub, separate shower, dual-sink vanity, and large walk-in closet. There's also a big separate laundry room, and all appliances convey with the sale. The equestrian facilities here are impressive and rare for the area: a 30' x 90' six-stall barn with turnouts and electricity, plus a massive 280' x 160'arena (roughly the size of a football field) that includes chutes, boxes, and a 15-foot alleyway. Behind the house you'll find a huge open yard perfect for RV parking, off-road toys, or simply enjoying the space. Additional highlights include full perimeter fencing, a concrete tile roof, automatic exterior sensor lights  and a solar-powered light at the main gate and located 1/2 mile from asphalt street. Very private as adjoining parcels are undeveloped. Just minutes away is the local town center with restaurants, a feed and hardware store, country market with gas and food service, plus the community fire station and center

With a great price point and a layout perfect for a growing family, someone looking to downsize or that great fit for someone working from home, this property was meant for you!

results.remarks: 5-acre custom Craftsman ranch in a secluded Kings Canyon community. Surrounded by mature pines and natural beauty, this peaceful retreat offers privacy, space and endless potential. Inside, the living, dining, kitchen and hallway areas feature tile flooring for durability and easy care. The spacious living room centers around a wood-burning stove on a flagstone hearth with stacked-stone surround, adding warmth and character. The kitchen offers generous workspace and storage, including a spacious pantry and center island with Brazilian Rain Forest marble countertop and Kohler double sink. A standout feature is the Capital 48-inch professional range with 6 burners, griddle and double ovens, plus pot filler, ideal for cooking or entertaining. Abundant cabinetry and counter space provide excellent storage, and the vent hood matches the wood cabinetry for a cohesive look. All appliances remain, including refrigerator. All bedrooms feature neutral sculpted carpet and ceiling fans. The primary bedroom is on one side of the home, while two additional bedrooms and guest bath are on the other for added privacy. The primary suite includes a large walk-in closet and French doors to the covered patio. The primary bath features dual-sink tiled vanity and tiled shower. Guest bath offers tiled vanity with backsplash, tub/shower combo and linen closet. Laundry room features tile flooring, abundant cabinetry, folding counter and space for extra refrigerator or freezer. Washer, dryer and stand-up freezer included. Exterior door provides easy access for cleanup after outdoor activities. Added features include central heat and air, ducted evaporative cooler, tankless water heater, recessed lighting and attic access. Generator-ready system powers TV, internet, refrigerator, lights and fans. Outside offers chain-link fencing, carport parking and wide-open space to enjoy the canyon landscape.
